import zlib,struct

p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,=struct.unpack('>I',d[p:p+4]);t=d[p+4:p+8];b=d[p+8:p+8+l];p+=12+l
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=b
raw=zlib.decompress(idat);W,H,bpp=244,32,3;s=W*bpp
rows=[];prev=bytearray(s);o=0
for y in range(H):

    for i in range(s):
        a=line[i-bpp] if i>=bpp else 0;b=prev[i];c=prev[i-bpp] if i>=bpp else 0
        if f==1:line[i]=(line[i]+a)&255
        elif f==2:line[i]=(line[i]+b)&255
        elif f==3:line[i]=(line[i]+(a+b)//2)&255
        elif f==4:
            pa=abs(b-c);pb=abs(a-c);pc=abs(a+b-2*c)
            pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
            line[i]=(line[i]+pr)&255
    rows.append(line);prev=line
bg=rows[0][0:3]
for y in range(2,30,4):
    print(''.join('#' if abs(rows[y][x*3]-bg[0])+abs(rows[y][x*3+1]-bg[1])+abs(rows[y][x*3+2]-bg[2])>150 else '.' for x in range(2,244,2)))
